summary: Iteration 3 — verified ShelfWise renewal banner + SLA + /api/membership/status. Added 4 new pytest cases to /app/backend/tests/test_medstore.py covering all four membership/status scenarios (admin, fresh free, premium near-expiry, premium far-expiry) — all 22/22 backend tests pass in 9.62s. Frontend Playwright (desktop): logged in as renewal-test user (r1777380813@t.com / pass1234, premium expires 2026-05-01 ~3 days out) — top renewal banner [data-testid='renewal-banner'] is visible with text 'Premium expires in 3 days — renew ₹600 to keep tracking your stock.' and the [data-testid='renew-now-btn'] navigates to /membership on click. /membership Current plan card shows the SLA box containing both 'Premium activates within 30 minutes' and 'manual monthly renewal' phrases. Admin login (admin@medstore.com) → no renewal banner shown (needs_renewal=false). Free user on /membership → renewal banner NOT shown. Screenshot captured at /app/.screenshots/renewal_user.png.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/membership/status correctly returns is_premium, is_admin, expires_at, days_left, needs_renewal, activation_sla_minutes=30. needs_renewal is gated by is_premium AND not is_admin AND days_left<=5 — admin correctly returns needs_renewal=false even though admin's days_left would otherwise qualify (10-year expiry). Good.
expiry_alert_loop renewal_reminder branch: dedupe uses 20h threshold while loop sleeps 24h — overlap fine; check uses sort by sent_at desc + 20h cooldown. Acceptable.

RenewalBanner.jsx is render-once (fetches /membership/status in useEffect with [user] dep). It will NOT auto-refresh if a user is granted premium mid-session, but acceptable for MVP — they'll see updated status on next page reload.
Banner uses bg-destructive when days<=1, bg-accent otherwise — color contrast OK in both tones (verified via screenshot).
review_request mentions 'sends renewal reminder email 0..5 days before expiry, dedupes for 20h' — backend code matches: 0<=days_left<=5 with 20h dedupe. All good.
test for premium-near-expiry directly mutates premium_expires_at via pymongo since /admin/users/{id}/grant only adds 30*months days. Acceptable test-only path; doesn't affect production code.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@medstore.com / Admin@12345. Renewal-test user: r1777380813@t.com / pass1234 (premium ~3 days out).
seed_data_creation: pytest run registers TEST_free_*, TEST_approve_*, TEST_near_*, TEST_far_* users (TEST_near + TEST_far are deleted in finally; others persist). One TEST_fe_renew_* user left in DB from frontend run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requirements from review_request iteration 3 verified PASS. Backend 22/22 pytest including 4 new membership/status tests. Frontend renewal banner verified on renewal-test user (3d to expiry), navigates correctly to /membership via renew-now-btn, SLA box on Membership shows '30 minutes' + 'manual monthly renewal'. Admin and free users correctly do NOT show banner. New testids: renewal-banner, renew-now-btn. The SMTP layer is MOCKED (logs only when SMTP_HOST unset); renewal_reminder emails use the same mock. Background loop wasn't directly tested via UI/API since it runs once a day with 5s startup delay — only the endpoint surface and dedupe logic were code-reviewed; if needed, can be tested by triggering loop manually via a test-only endpoint.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs encountered. All review_request acceptance criteria verified pass.
